verdicts.source_revision_contract: cooperative transaction lock + entity clock + immutable complete outbox; all affected IDs published in same transaction
verdicts.cross_topic_versioning: does not compare partition offsets; complete snapshots required
verdicts.deletion: clock and ES marker retained; filtered alias does not filter GET
verdicts.idempotence: same ID insufficient; equal revision and exact payload fingerprint required; conflicting payload blocks
verdicts.offsets: manual per partition, after full batch applied/noop/durably parked; no crossing unresolved gap
verdicts.failures: only known item mapping 400 may park; script/config/unknown errors stop; bounded transient retry and unknown outcomes covered
verdicts.DLQ: ack awaited before source commit, duplicate isolation possible, retained original pending record and offline repair audit
verdicts.visibility: explicit refresh; GET, search and consumer commit distinguished
verdicts.scope: single VM/broker/partition/consumer; serial cooperating writers; no HA/throughput/online rebuild/exactly-once claim
verdicts.source_and_runtime_versions: official fixed-tag target files HTTP200 match local; build/runtime receipts separate
verdicts.snippets: source ranges synchronized; commit excerpt starts at apply and includes commitSync
